prompt: In the users table (src/app/(main)/dashboard/users/_components/), a search that matches no one shows the bare text "No results." in a table cell. Replace it with a proper empty state built on the app's Empty component: the title "No users found", a line that repeats what was searched, and a "Clear search" button that empties the search box so every user shows again.

constraints.text: Built on the app's Empty component (src/components/ui/empty.tsx) and Button, not a new hand-made block.
No colour, size or spacing typed by hand: the theme's tokens and Tailwind's scale only.
Right for a long search text, in the dark theme and in a narrow window; the table with results unchanged.
The empty state is announced when it appears; "Clear search" is a real button.
Only the users page's components change; the Empty component itself is unchanged, and no test is removed.
